Hermes merged 107 PRs on October 7

The ones worth knowing:

• Voice turns can now run on their own faster model through auxiliary.voice_chat, so spoken replies stop waiting on your main model.
• A full or read-only disk no longer stops the cron scheduler. Jobs catch up once storage recovers, and the outage shows in cron status, doctor and your home channel.
• Long-running cron jobs stop getting reclaimed as "wedged" at the 2 hour mark while they're still working.
• hermes update got sturdier: a docs-only local edit or a leftover git index.lock no longer breaks the next update, and Linux/macOS gateways pause before code swaps and restart after deps.
• pm gc now reclaims dependency state from deleted worktrees and clones. One host went from 92 GB down to 18 GB.
• Vision models can finally see images returned by MCP tools, and every image tool respects image_input_mode.
• Webhook, LINE, SMS, WhatsApp Cloud and Raft inbound now refuse blank or empty signing secrets, and secrets get scrubbed on every memory provider hand-off.
• Anthropic OAuth sessions keep compression and auxiliary calls working after a silent token refresh.
• Desktop gets theme typography controls and a Chat Text Size setting, and SSH connect now works when the remote shell is fish.
• Claude Haiku 5.5 lands in the OpenRouter and Nous Portal pickers, and Bedrock Claude Opus 5 and 5.5 now get priced.
• A busy state.db no longer kills a running turn, and a corrupt search index no longer aborts session search rebuilds.
• The plugin catalog added 15 new entries, including fish-audio, alice-voice, switchbot-control, klipper-print-watch and several new memory providers.

Here is the full list:

DESKTOP IMPROVEMENTS (18 PRs)

• fix(desktop): honor default remote SSH profile
• fix(desktop): SSH Test/connect no longer fails when the remote login shell is fish
• feat(desktop): theme typography knobs + Chat Text Size control
• test(desktop): pin one backend per host across reconnect storms and the orphan reap
• fix(desktop): explain missing remote profiles
• fix(desktop): preserve intentional turn interruptions
• fix(desktop): Windows SSH host locks let a superseded backend retire
• fix(browser+desktop): keep local browser automation invisible on Windows Desktop
• fix(desktop): hide unknown cloud agent status
• fix(desktop): widen the inline image preview envelope so stacked image sets stay viewable
• fix(desktop): make auto-project Hide from sidebar reversible via an Undo toast
• fix(desktop): show a queued cron run row immediately after Trigger now
• test(desktop-update): a macOS app swap killed at any step recovers to one complete bundle
• A branched chat no longer gets stuck on a loading spinner
• Windows 11 25H2: real-profile browsing and the updater window find the default browser
• docs: Desktop Light is no longer presented as a downloadable remote-only client
• fix(desktop): default UI Scale to 100% and keep chat text at 110%
• fix(desktop): give fresh group threads room context

VOICE & REAL-TIME (5 PRs)

• Voice turns can run on their own faster model via auxiliary.voice_chat
• fix(stt): local turbo model is selectable in every STT picker
• feat(plugin-catalog): add fish-audio plugin
• feat(plugin-catalog): add alice-voice plugin
• feat(plugin-catalog): bump stt-vocab to 1.1.0

DEVELOPER TOOLS & PLUGINS (33 PRs)

• fix: disclose enabled plugins' skills in the system prompt's available_skills
• feat(plugins): a portable package can ask Hermes to gate its MCP server
• feat(kanban): one workflow definition for board columns
• Background review can improve every skill instead of dropping lessons for user-owned ones

• fix(telemetry): update stage rows count the stage a failed run died in
• chore(memory): remove the bundled openviking provider

• feat(plugin-catalog): bump aux-ledger to 1.1.0
• feat(plugin-catalog): bump stream-speed to 1.1.0

• Monitoring Dashboard catalog pin moves to e4825262 (skill demo commands)

SECURITY & SECRETS (6 PRs)

• fix(mcp): reject fabricated DCR for providers without RFC 7591 registration
• Webhook, LINE, SMS, WhatsApp Cloud and Raft inbound refuse blank, null or empty-key signing secrets
• fix(memory): scrub secrets on every memory-provider hand-off
• fix(auth): a profile's own auth add login is saved and kept, never forking root's grant
• Anthropic OAuth sessions keep compression and auxiliary calls working after a silent token refresh, including compaction before the first request
• fix(auth): discover external-process CLIs in the user-local bin on thin-PATH backends

INTEGRATIONS & CHAT (11 PRs)

• fix(plugins/telegram): clamp negative inline-query offsets to page zero
• fix(copilot): recompute api_mode on fallback and stop stale-mode veto
• Vision models see MCP image results; every image tool honours image_input_mode
• A cron fire into a cold-starting gateway delivers to relay DMs
• fix(photon): keep the user's words when they reply in an iMessage thread

STABILITY & FIXES (34 PRs)

• fix(computer_use): recommend set_value on a zero-delivery type verdict

• fix(update): a docs-only local edit no longer makes hermes update roll back and exit 1
• fix(update): a killed git's index.lock no longer blocks the next update

• fix(cron): a full or read-only cron store no longer stops the scheduler; jobs catch up once on recovery and the outage shows in cron status, doctor, metrics and the home channel
• fix(cron): long-running jobs are no longer reclaimed as wedged at the 2 h stale bound while still active
• fix(terminal): a foreground call with heartbeat runs instead of looping on a refusal
• fix(pm): dependency state of deleted worktrees/clones is reclaimed by pm gc and the startup pruner (92 GB down to 18 GB on one host)
• fix(gateway): stop _ensure_windows_gateway_venv_imports leaking PYTHONPATH into global environment
• fix(web): bound the dashboard build's CPU and heap
• fix(dashboard): render thinking markup as structured reasoning in the session transcript
• fix(dashboard): report the loopback identity from /api/auth/me instead of 401
• fix(kanban): read/watch paths no longer resurrect archived or deleted boards
• The cancelled-mid-close marker fix for 1:1 dashboard terminals gets a deterministic regression test
• hermes update from v2026.9.24 no longer crashes on local_runtime's gpu_class import
• CI runs the update E2Es when a package __init__ on the update path changes
• test: close the review gaps on the merged relay, classifier and prompt-cache tests
• Cron external workers no longer relaunch after their ack and leave the run unknown
• Provider-catalog E2E is green again on main: LM Studio and TokenHub profiles name their API-key env vars
• Linux/macOS gateways pause before the update swaps code, restart after deps
• test(providers): a profile missing its API-key env var fails the default lane, not only the skippable e2e lane
• test: detached-writer custody tests never read a pid from a torn heartbeat file
• fix(tests): runner applies passthrough --ignore-glob; windows marker test stops sitting out 150s
• fix(cron): close three store-outage gaps from the cron store review (stuck one-shot, lock-only outage, symlinked cron/)
• A busy state.db no longer kills a running turn as a lost lease
• test(ci): the CI replay does not run Git Bash under x64 emulation on Windows arm64
• fix(kanban): only sweep a parent workspace once the parent itself is terminal
• fix(ts): npm run fix
• refactor(onboarding): simplify onboarding follow-ups
• fix(state): a corrupt FTS index no longer aborts the session-search rebuild and optimize passes
• fmt(js): `npm run fix` auto-fix
• Main CI is green again: web_build_limits.py routes to the update e2e lanes

PROMPT SHARE: The biggest AI breakthrough isn’t realism. It’s presence.

#AIVideo #Marketing #Advertising

The people, movement, noise and unpredictability give the world a sense of life beyond the camera.

That’s when generation starts becoming experience.

➜ Image Prompt:

Photography & Cinematography
Create an ultra-realistic nighttime street portrait with the raw, spontaneous look of early-2000s nightlife photography. Direct on-camera flash illuminates the subject sharply against a much darker city background, with natural grain, slight highlight blowout, deep shadows, imperfect exposure and authentic point-and-shoot character. No fake or plastic skin, no beauty filtering, no CGI or animated appearance.

Character & Pose
A striking young man with rugged, high-fashion model features, lean athletic build, sharply defined jawline and cheekbones, strong brows, full lips and short dark hair styled wet and tousled with loose curls falling onto his forehead. Natural pores, subtle facial texture and realistic imperfections. He sits casually on the edge of a city curb at night, legs spread asymmetrically, one knee raised toward the camera. One forearm rests loosely across the raised knee while his other hand reaches down beside him toward a small shaggy brown dog partially entering the bottom of the frame. He looks directly into the camera with a serious, confident expression.

Outfit
Fitted black long-sleeve turtleneck, faded distressed gray-blue jeans with worn areas and small rips, and a black leather belt. Silver pendant necklace, small hoop earring, chunky silver cuff bracelet, dark oversized wristwatch, and a thin bracelet. Styling feels slightly rebellious, understated and naturally lived-in rather than polished.

Environment
A busy urban nightlife street after dark. Several casually dressed people walk behind him, cropped naturally by the frame, while parked and passing cars create scattered headlights and small pools of distant light. The pavement is gritty and imperfect with curbs, cracks and ordinary street details visible. Keep the background activity believable and incidental—the image should feel like a real moment caught outside a club or late-night gathering, not a staged fashion shoot. Wide horizontal composition, intimate close-range flash photography, authentic real-world energy.

几乎所有 reward model 都在做同一个简化：把人类偏好压成一个分数。

但真实的人类反馈往往不是一个点——同一个回答，不同人可以给出不同、甚至互相冲突的判断。把多峰偏好硬压成标量，模型学到的只是"平均值"，而不是"人们到底怎么想"。

清华 THUNLP 的新工作 DRM（Diffusion Reward Model）换了个问法：能不能让奖励模型学人类偏好的分布？

做法很干净——把 reward modeling 重新表述为对 p(r | x, y) 的条件密度估计：在冻结的 LLM encoder 之上，用轻量 Diffusion Transformer 从高斯噪声去噪出奖励向量。不对输出分布做任何参数假设，多峰结构自然被表示出来。
一个架构同时吃多属性回归和成对偏好数据；推理时采 N 个样本就是经验奖励分布，可以聚合成标量、方差或分位数。

结果（五个基准）： • 在数据与 backbone 对齐下不弱于基线 • 训练规模相对小，仍能与大得多的判别式 / 分布式 / 生成式 RM 抗衡 • 常规 head 把分布坍缩成一个点时，它能恢复出多峰结构

更实用的是下游：用不确定性做拒绝采样、用 LCB 聚合——而且直接拿 DRM 当 RLHF 训练时的 reward，策略表现更好。这就不只是"更细的评估指标"，而是能直接改善训练。

一句话：奖励不该是一个点，而是一个分布。
